papers.title: Hallmarks of aging: An expanding universe
papers.claim_summary: Review proposes twelve interconnected hallmarks of aging; this is not evidence of achieved human immortality.
limitations: Review and conceptual synthesis, not a trial demonstrating human immortality.
Mechanistic and species-specific findings must not be translated directly to clinical use.
papers.contrary_evidence_question: What human controlled studies support clinically meaningful outcomes for any proposed intervention?

papers.title: Dorsoventral-mediated Shh induction is required for axolotl limb regeneration
papers.claim_summary: Axolotl limb patterning experiments investigate dorsoventral contact and Shh induction; they do not establish human regeneration or immortality.
limitations: Findings concern axolotl limb patterning, not longevity in humans.
Translation to other species is an unanswered research question.
papers.contrary_evidence_question: What independent replications test this mechanism, and what limitations emerge in other species?
